Toast

.dr-toast · .is-on · --over-sheet · components/toast.css · kit specimen

Anatomy

Link copied.
  1. 1.dr-toastThe surface: a pill with 12 / 20 padding, body 14 at weight 600 and line 1.4, --text-on-inverse on --bg-inverse at 15.99:1. It floats, so it spends --shadow-raised.
  2. 2.is-onThe shown state: opacity 1, no offset. Without it the toast sits 8px low at opacity 0 and takes no clicks; the rise is 0.15s.
  3. 3[role="status"]Announced without taking focus (WCAG 4.1.3). No screen writes this markup: the shell (_wf-shell.js) builds this one div the first time a data-toast control is tapped.

Variants and sizes

Inventory rows: (.dr-toast).

States

No state of its own: the toast announces through role="status" without taking focus, and it takes no clicks.

When to use

A toast is a transient confirmation for an action that finishes on the screen you are standing on and leaves no other trace. It is the product's one inverted surface and one of two that float, with the sheet. Any control carrying data-toast raises it; it dismisses itself after 4s and on click, and nothing depends on reading it in time (WCAG 2.2.1), because it states the action just taken. Three controls raise one today: Copy link on share, Mark resolved on contact-support, and Notify me when available on order-setup-empty.

State the fact; add a second sentence only when the user would otherwise have to come back and check. One toast, one function: two controls that do different things never say the same sentence. Link copied. · Issue marked resolved. · Saved. We'll tell you when an operator is free. Never Copied!, never Done, never successfully.

Rule and anti-rule

Do

Saved. We'll tell you when an operator is free.

order-setup-empty: the request is stored and nothing else on the screen changes, so the toast is the only trace, and its second sentence spares the user a return visit.

Don’t

Payment declined. Try again.

An error in a toast. An error is a state the user must be able to re-read, and a toast leaves after 4s. Use the message block. No toast either where the result is already on screen: a file in its upload well, a switch that moved, a screen that replaces this one.
